research_question: How does the minimum verified useful separator size k_min(n) behave on a preregistered finite family and untouched holdout when discovery, proof verification, all 2^k boundary rows, recomposition, replay and provenance are fully costed?

minimum_separator_detector.search_order: k=1,2,3,4; lexicographic subsets within each k
minimum_separator_detector.selected_separator: lexicographically first verified separator at minimum k
minimum_separator_detector.proof_of_minimality: zero verified separators for every smaller k plus exact separator certificate at found k
discovery_cost_must_include: clause partition verification for each separating candidate

boundary_table.SAT_authority: at least one row exact SAT and reconstructed assignment verifies on original CNF
boundary_table.UNKNOWN_child: forbids UNSAT authority and yields UNKNOWN_BUDGET unless a separately verified SAT row exists

promotion_gates.calibration_exact: 8/8 expected SAT/UNSAT and expected minimum k
promotion_gates.holdout_exact: 6/6 expected SAT/UNSAT and expected minimum k
promotion_gates.minimum_k_proof: all smaller-k candidate sets exhausted on every separator fixture
promotion_gates.gate0_regression: 5/5 verdict exact and auto-detector finds k=1
promotion_gates.gate1_regression: 5/5 verdict exact and auto-detector finds k=2
promotion_gates.ribbon: same POSITION; distinct ORIGIN, ORIGIN_PRIME_1, ORIGIN_PRIME_2 states
